name: The Stars Are Right
text: Bonded (Stargazing). Revelation - Remove The Stars Are Right from the game. Choose an investigator. That investigator draws 1 card, gains 1 resource, and may take an immediate action as if it were their turn (this action does not count toward the number of actions that investigator can take each turn).
text_cn: 绑定(仰望星空)。 显现 - 将群星正确之时移出游戏。选择一位调查员。该调查员抽取1张卡牌，获得1资源，并且可以立即进行一次行动，如同在自己回合(本行动不计入该调查员每回合可进行的行动数)。
